transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for joining this review session. As you know, we have a student who was below the college's academic-standing standard and has submitted a draft academic recovery contract for the spring term. The student has also asked to return to regular enrollment after the spring term. Before I can approve and sign the final contract, I need to gather any relevant information from each of you to make sure the contract is complete. The contract must state the student's enrollment plan, any conditions for continued enrollment, and the support services that will be monitored. I'd like to go around and hear from each of you -- academic advisor, registrar, counselor, and financial-aid specialist -- regarding anything I need to know to finalize this contract.
